storyCards.headline: Wait: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
White Lion's "Wait" reached #8 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Wait" is a power ballad recorded by White Lion and written by White Lion vocalist Mike Tramp and guitarist Vito Bratta.

The song peaked at #8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Wait was released in 1987.
